===============================================================================
2. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE & STEALTH ENGINE
===============================================================================

Gray Scrape combines:

1. TLSv1.3 Fingerprint Emulation:
   - Emulates Chrome ClientHello with GREASE extensions, ALPN HTTP/2 priority headers, and X25519 cipher suites.
   - Sets authentic Client Hints: Sec-Ch-Ua, Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform, Sec-Ch-Ua-Arch, Sec-Ch-Ua-Bitness.

2. Anti-Bot & WAF Challenge Evasion:
   - Cloudflare Turnstile Solver: Bypasses JS challenge screens, managed challenges, and Turnstile widgets.
   - Canvas Noise Generator: Randomizes HTML5 canvas readback operations (`toDataURL`, `getImageData`) to block canvas fingerprint tracking.
   - WebRTC Leak Shield: Restricts STUN/TURN peer candidate gathering to prevent public/private IP address leaks.
   - Google Referrer Spoofing: Injects organic Google Search referrers (`https://www.google.com/search?q=...`).
   - Ad & Tracker Domain Blocker: Filters requests against ~3,500 tracking domains.

3. Adaptive DOM Relocation Engine (`adapt_css`):
   - Multi-factor element fingerprinting (tag name, ID, class overlap, text Levenshtein similarity, depth, parent hierarchy, sibling signature).
   - Automatically relocates target DOM nodes when websites update layout or obfuscate CSS class names.

4. Reader Mode & Formatting:
   - Converts HTML to token-optimized Markdown.
   - Pads inline links cleanly to avoid stuck text.
   - Optional `# Links` section appends hyperlinked citations when `includeLinks: true` (default: false).

===============================================================================
3. REST API CONTRACT
===============================================================================

Endpoint: POST https://gray-scrape.vercel.app/api/scrape

JSON Request Body Parameters:
- `url` (string, required): The target webpage URL.
- `selector` (string, optional): CSS selector to track adaptively.
- `stealthMode` (boolean, default: true): Toggle stealth engine.
- `includeImages` (boolean, default: true): Extract images and avatars.
- `includeLinks` (boolean, default: false): Include link markdown and append `# Links`.
- `solveCloudflare` (boolean, default: true): Turnstile solver.
- `hideCanvas` (boolean, default: true): Canvas anti-fingerprint noise.
- `blockWebrtc` (boolean, default: true): WebRTC IP leak shield.
- `googleReferrer` (boolean, default: true): Organic referrer.
- `blockAdsAndTrackers` (boolean, default: true): Tracker domain filtering.

===============================================================================
4. CLI COMMAND SPECIFICATION
===============================================================================

Command: npx gray-scrape <url> [flags]

Flags:
- `-s, --selector <css>`: Target CSS selector
- `-f, --format <fmt>`: `markdown` | `json` | `text` | `html`
- `--links`: Enable link extraction & `# Links` paragraph
- `--no-images`: Strip image tags
- `-o, --output <path>`: Output file path
- `-v, --verbose`: Display latency and stealth metrics

===============================================================================
5. LLM AGENT IMPLEMENTATION SNIPPET
===============================================================================

JavaScript / TypeScript Tool:
```typescript
async function readWebPage(url: string, selector?: string): Promise<string> {
  const res = await fetch('https://gray-scrape.vercel.app/api/scrape', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ url, selector, stealthMode: true, includeLinks: false }),
  });
  const data = await res.json();
  return data.readerMode?.markdown || '';
}
```
